ME Beginning May 18 South Water Elevator Will Be Closed

Starting May 18, the South Water elevator will be closed during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren St or Museum Campus/11th St for elevator access. For the latest service alert info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.

UPW Kedzie Station Construction
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

MED Flossmoor Elevator Out of Service
The Flossmoor elevator is out of service.  Customers can use Homewood or Calumet as alternate boarding stations.

MDW Train #2720 is on the move

MDW train #2720, scheduled to arrive Chicago Union Station at 9:58 PM, is on the move and may be operating 20 to 25 minutes behind schedule, due to freight train interference. Metra will provide updates as information becomes available.

Sunday, July 19, No Train Service On UP-Northwest Line - Scheduled Track Repairs
On Sunday, July 19, there will be no train service on the UP-Northwest line due to scheduled track repairs. Make your alternate travel plans at Metra.com, Transitchicago.com, or Pacebus.com.

Union Pacific North Line Ravinia Park Station Notice

Beginning July 11, Metra trains will stop at the Ravinia Park Station starting at 5 p.m. Weekend service to Ravinia Park will begin mid-morning and continue throughout the day when events are scheduled.

RID - 115th St./Morgan Park Station Construction

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are now open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.
